name: @ezpug/gamemodes
description: The gamemode manifests EZPug Iron ships, one directory per mode, authored as data (decision 14), and beside an sdk mode's manifest the source of its phone widget, built by @ezpug/gamemode-kit into <id>/dist/widget.js (decision 17). Read by the orchestrator, bundled into @ezpug/match-api as the catalog the fake serves, built against by the plugins.
